articles.title: BlackRock seeks to shield bitcoin investors from losses after rival fund weathers 50% crash
articles.snippet: BlackRock's proposed fund follows similar products from Calamos that helped investors avoid steep losses during bitcoin's selloff.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
articles.snippet: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining offshoot Nscale loses Microsoft AI deal as power delay stretches into 2030s
articles.snippet: The Nvidia-backed company planned to deliver 23,000 AI chips in the U.K. next year, but its grid connection may not be ready until the 2030s.

articles.title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.
